skills.name: qa-detect-forced-colors

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-loading-states
skills.description: Tests loading-state behavior under simulated slow network. skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-mobile-keyboard
skills.description: Detects layout that breaks when the on-screen keyboard appears AND inputs with wrong type/inputmode that show the wrong keyboard on mobile (QWERTY instead of numpad, etc.). Runs as ONE in-page async probe (no AI hand-driving).
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-modal-viewport-fit
skills.description: Tests open modals / dialogs: verify they fit within the viewport height, action buttons (Submit/Cancel) are reachable, and content scrolls internally rather than the modal overflowing. Runs as ONE in-page async probe (no AI hand-driving).
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-orientation
skills.description: Detects layout breakage in landscape orientation on mobile/tablet — swaps viewport dimensions and scans for overflow, cut-off content, and unusable navigation.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-overflow-controls
skills.description: Detects tab strips, segmented controls, and button groups whose children overflow horizontally without a visible scroll affordance
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-reduced-motion
skills.description: WCAG 2.3.3 — detects animations/transitions that are not gated by @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). Vestibular-disorder users get sick from motion.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-responsive-images
skills.description: Detects images served without srcset, missing max-width:100%, missing loading='lazy' below the fold, and oversized natural dimensions for the viewport
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-safe-area

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-sticky-scroll

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-touch
skills.description: Detects tap targets that are too small for accurate touch input, using WCAG 2.2 spacing-aware rules: <24×24 always flagged, 24-43 px flagged only when crowded by another clickable target within 24px. Also flags interactive elements <8px apart.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-touch-interactions
skills.description: Dispatches real TouchEvent (touchstart/touchend) on elements that have hover-only handlers, to detect controls that work with mouse but not with touch. Tests tap, double-tap-to-zoom suppression, swipe gestures. Runs as ONE in-page async probe.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-typography

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-typography-advanced
skills.description: Real typography DEFECTS only (trimmed 2026-06-09 to remove cosmetic/opinion noise): failed web fonts, real WCAG contrast failures, tofu/replacement glyphs, mixed-content (blocked) fonts, and missing/invalid html lang. skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-typography-responsive
skills.description: Closes the responsive/legibility typography gaps not covered by qa-detect-typography(-advanced): font appropriateness per viewport, fluid (clamp/vw) type scaling, justified-without-hyphens rivers, text over background images without a scrim, px sizing that ignores user font-size preference, and missing tabular figures in numeric tables.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-affordance
skills.description: Detects affordance UX failures: clickable elements that don't look clickable, hover-only revealed actions (dead on mobile/touch), missing focus indicators, cursor:default on interactives, text inputs without visible borders. Catches the 'I didn't know I could click that' bug class.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-card-usage
skills.description: Detects illogical use of the card pattern: a giant card containing only a single small input (your Search-only card), card with > 70% empty space relative to content, cards nested 3+ levels deep, card with substantial content but no heading, card heading separated from content by big gap.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-cross-page-theme
skills.description: Detects color/theme drift ACROSS pages — sidebar background color changes between routes, header bar uses different hues on different pages, theme primary varies across the audit run, active-state color drifts. The per-cell probe records color fingerprints; scripts/check-cross-page-theme.cjs aggregates them after the run and emits findings.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-format-consistency
skills.description: Detects mixed display formats for the same kind of data on a single page: date formats (5/6/2026 vs 2026-06-05 vs Jun 5 2026), currency formats (PKR 93M vs Rs. 93,000,000 vs $93M), number formats (1,000 vs 1.000 vs 1k), time formats (17:17 vs 5:17 PM), phone formats. Catches the 'why is the same data shown three different ways' bug class.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-icons
skills.description: Catches icon UX problems: icon-only buttons without tooltip, icons without accessible labels, ambiguous icon meaning, oversized/undersized icons, icon-text gap inconsistency. skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-nav-icons
skills.description: Detects nav/sidebar/tab consistency issues: icons mixed with iconless items, icon size variance across siblings, icon style mix (filled/outlined/colored), label-icon vertical misalignment, missing active-state indicator, label truncation. Catches the 'sidebar looks sloppy' bug class.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-overlap
skills.description: Detects visible elements that physically overlap each other on screen — toolbar buttons sitting on top of table headers, calendar text collision, modal partially behind another modal, sticky banner covering content. Catches the 'why are these two things on top of each other' bug class.
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-page-header
skills.description: Detects page-header layout problems — page title smaller than metric/content text (broken typographic hierarchy), page title sitting before the home icon in the breadcrumb row, page title text duplicated as a breadcrumb item, home icon not the first breadcrumb item, page title using same style as breadcrumb. Runs even when there is no breadcrumb. Goes beyond qa-detect-ux-breadcrumb which checks the breadcrumb itself in isolation.
